snapshot.description: Industria enclosure designed to house the official Raspberry Pi 5-inch Touch Display 2. Integrates the RPi display into the Industria industrial form factor.
features: Passive heatsink with optional active cooling module support
Full USB, Ethernet, HDMI, and GPIO port access
Supports Raspberry Pi HAT expansion via GPIO
Compatible with M.2 NVMe expansion (optional accessory)
VESA, panel, and desktop mounting compatible
Rugged aluminum construction for demanding industrial environments
Expandable architecture supporting HATs and communication modules
Compatible with official Raspberry Pi 5-inch Touch Display 2 (720 × 1280 MIPI)
Optional M.2 NVMe expansion via PCIe M.2 Single NVMe Board accessory
